items.name: PAN_RANGE
items.doc: The PAN travel — −1 (hard left) … 0 (center) … +1 (hard right). A property of the pan law itself, not of any desk, so it is declared once. Continuous: a pan position has no quantum, and panGains clamps to these bounds.

items.name: DIVERGENCE_RANGE

source.origin: the console engine's LCR divergence travel DIVERGENCE_RANGE

items.doc: The LCR divergence travel: 0 is a hard discrete centre, 1 full phantom, the stereo image. A property of the LCR panner law itself, the same authority class as PAN_RANGE: no device narrows it.
